benchmarks.name: runtime_mix
benchmarks.contract: Scalar dependent recurrence; bounded signed i64 arithmetic; zero kernel allocations; runtime seed and iterations.

benchmarks.name: dynamic_gather
benchmarks.contract: Fully initialized 4096-slot i64 stack buffer, active-length checked random read/modify/write; identical LCG and bounds contract; zero kernel allocations.

benchmarks.name: indexed_graph
benchmarks.contract: 4096 initialized inline {i64 next,i64 value} nodes; index-based mutable graph walk, not yet safe pointers; fixed-capacity bounds; zero kernel allocations.

benchmarks.name: overlap_views
benchmarks.contract: Sequential overlapping reads/writes, identical storage and update order; Rust uses one mutable slice; zero kernel allocations.

benchmarks.name: matrix4
benchmarks.contract: Explicit 4x4 i64 matrix/vector recurrence with fixed output buffer; bounded integer arithmetic; no BLAS/fast-math/allocation.

benchmarks.name: ring_pipeline
benchmarks.contract: Three cap-64 batch buffers, one thread, identical stage/drain order; scheduler-free baseline, not a measurement of brew/channel overhead.
